title: DiffHarbor review.json
description: Per-repo settings for DiffHarbor, in the repo root. All keys are optional; unknown keys are ignored.

repoPath.description: A path inside the repo, from its root.

ignore.description: Globs (*, **, ?); a path without one takes its folder.

tests.description: Run the tests of changed packages. Unset: only when no CI workflow does.

packages.description: Overrides per monorepo part; the longest glob wins.

syntax_theme.description: Shiki theme names for the report's code colors.

install_scripts.description: Run lifecycle scripts (postinstall, native builds) in the checks' installs. Default false.

base_branches.description: Globs of base branches besides the default branch whose PRs get reviewed without asking.

tickets.description: itsaplan or Linear projects (team keys) a PR may name; unset = any, [] = none.
